"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The cost and complexity of complying with Dodd-Frank has created impediments to the remaining banks' ability to support their customers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In 1985, there were 13,000 community banks.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Dodd-Frank's excessive regulation and burdensome requirements have contributed to the slow economy under President Obama and the Democrats.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Community banks are essential to ensuring small businesses have easy and affordable access to the capital they need to grow and prosper.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for relieving community banks of excessive regulations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for removing roadblocks and regulations that prevent access to capital.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau is deliberately designed to be a rogue agency.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau answers to neither Congress nor the executive.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau uses its slush fund to steer settlements to politically favored groups.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
